overview.intro: The Ubiquity API lets you build discovery pipelines that find and curate sources and entities for a topic and location, then track and refine the resulting feed over time.

servers.https://ubiquity.filterlabs.ai/api: Main reverse-proxied backend for pipelines, feeds, jobs and search.
servers.https://auth.filterlabs.ai: Keycloak authentication server used to obtain and refresh access tokens.

overview.authentication: Clients authenticate against the Keycloak server to obtain a Bearer access token, which is sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on every request. Access tokens are short-lived and must be refreshed periodically using the refresh token issued at login.
families: Pipelines, feeds, saved searches, jobs, entities, permissions and organizations.
Parses search queries and launches discovery jobs.
Conversational chat sessions and generated artifacts.

conventions.text: All list endpoints support `limit` and `offset` query parameters for pagination.
Resource identifiers are UUIDs unless otherwise noted.

status_codes: Invalid request or resource not found by a business-logic check.

workflow.title: Core workflow
workflow.lead: A typical integration parses a query into a saved search, creates a pipeline and feed from it, launches a discovery job, and then polls the job until sources are ready for review.
steps: Parse a free-text query into entities and a location.
Persist the parsed query and filters.
Create a pipeline from a saved search.
Launch a discovery job for the pipeline.
